detection_method.description: Detection method: 'threshold' or 'stddev'. Must be one of these two values.

threshold_min.description: Lower bound for threshold detection; omit if not needed.

threshold_max.description: Upper bound for threshold detection; omit if not needed.

stddev_sample.description: Sample size for standard deviation detection; must be ≥ 2.

stddev_coefficient.description: Multiplier for sigma (standard deviation); higher values reduce sensitivity.

execute_program.description: Command to execute on anomaly detection (used only with response_mode='execute').

signal_pid.description: Target process ID to signal with USR1 (used only with response_mode='signal').

quiet.description: Suppress default descriptive message on anomaly detection.
